Ravi P.: quick heads-up: spotted a kv-cache leak that spikes 503s for embeddings during short bursts in prod-us-west. repro in load test. built hotfix image redwood/serving:hotfix-v2.2.0. Need expedited window: 03:15-03:30 UTC, request skip-canary + pin. need oncall + manager ack.

DeployBot: @ravi.p initiated staging deploy: image redwood/serving:hotfix-v2.2.0. Staging logs: https://staging-logs.internal/redwood/1840001234. Default canary: 10% for 5m. Manager override: `/deploy override --skip-canary`.

Nora (oncall): I'll run smoke and kv synthetic now. ping me when staging is ready.

Ravi P.: staging smoke quick paste:
```
[2026-04-02T03:12:05Z] embed-service WARN kv-cache close-to-capacity
[2026-04-02T03:12:07Z] embed-service INFO hotfix v2.2.0 applied, ttl fix engaged
[2026-04-02T03:12:12Z] embed-service INFO request success 200
```

Nora (oncall): staging looks good. running a 2m burst test, will report.

Priya - PM: customer escalations open for two accounts, approve expedited. please include an impact blurb for release notes.

Maya (Docs): draft available if you approve wording. suggested: "Fix: intermittent embedding 503s caused by kv-cache leak under burst load; reduced error rate and improved cache behavior."

ReleaseNotesBot: Draft saved: https://notes.internal/redwood/drafts/1840001234 (one-liner + impact + testing notes).

Liam Ops: +1 from ops. Approve skip-canary and pin. We'll monitor at 1m granularity for 10m. DeployBot, proceed and set pin.

DeployBot: Prod rollout starting per manager override (Liam Ops). Pin configured: `model-serving-prod -> v2.2.0-hotfix`. Canary: skipped. Rolling: 30% -> 70% -> 100%. Deploy stream: https://deploys.internal/redwood/1840001234.

Ravi P.: watching dashboards. alert rule temporarily set: embeddings 5xx > 0.3% over 1m triggers pager. rollback command if needed:
`/deploy rollback model-serving-prod --to v2.2.0-previous`

Nora (oncall): after 5m smoke in prod: sampled traffic good, no burst 503s seen. latency unchanged. :thumbsup:

Priya - PM: thanks everyone. paste final release notes link when live.

ReleaseNotesBot: Published: https://notes.internal/redwood/releases/2026-04-02-hotfix-v2.2.0  title: "hotfix: kv-cache leak mitigation (v2.2.0)". Changelog entry added.

Ravi P.: closing thread  prod stable after 12m. will open a short RCA ticket and track a permanent cache refactor. thanks for quick approvals. :white_check_mark:
